subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "**excited.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the sentence, which contains the blank it is given that** the water in the bathroom gave rise to the child in her.**

 
 
• **This phrase explains that the filled bathroom gave a happy and ecstatic feeling to her.**
 
• Just how we used to get excited to play in the water when we were kids, the subject also got excited.
 
 
 
• Thus, t**he correct word to use in the blank 4 is "excited."**
 
 
• **"Excited" means feeling or showing happiness and enthusiasm; not calm.**
 
• Example: They were very excited about their holiday.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.
